annotations.title: Options: put/call, max pain, implied volatility

description: Use this when someone asks about Bitcoin or Ethereum options: the put/call ratio, max pain, options open interest, implied volatility, or which strikes hold the most contracts. Read from Deribit every ten minutes: open interest in calls and puts (in coins and dollars), put/call by open interest and by 24-hour volume, max pain and at-the-money implied volatility for every expiry, the ten strikes holding the most contracts, and how the put/call ratio and implied volatility stood a day and a week earlier. Answers "what is BTC max pain this Friday", "is the put/call ratio rising" and "where is the biggest options strike on ETH". Live market data, not advice.
